# Davis Vanguard

> Non-profit investigative journalism platform dedicated to criminal justice reform, incarcerated voices, and local government accountability.

Davis Vanguard operates as a watchdog news organization covering local government, courts, and prisons with a focus on criminal justice reform. The organization publishes the Vanguard Incarcerated Press (VIP), which amplifies journalism from incarcerated writers and advocates for prison abolition and systemic reform.

## Key Topics

- Criminal Justice Reform
- Incarcerated Journalism
